notes.title: Version 1.1.2
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Hard Mode gets unlocked by collecting all Ebb Tabs in the respective Normal Mode stage now[/b]
[*]Fixed a bug where boost jumping against a wall would disable hovering after performing a walljump
[*]Fixed a bug where reloading Stage 2 after quitting to the home menu from the very first room would break the Stage
[*]Fixed a bug that made the rainbow bubbles in 2-3/2-H expand or shrink when entering them in too short intervals
[*]Added a safety check for rubbish generation
[/list]

[h2]Level Design[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the sponge's movement in the first room they appear in to avoid it getting stuck on the ceiling (2-H-4)
[*] Improved camera in second secret room below cake (3-1-9)
[*] Added a no-return sign to a secret room in 3-2 (3-2-24)
[*] Improved the camera in vertical secret room in 5-2 (5-2-S1)
[*] Made the cycles in the room with moving cannons and pillows coming out of windows more lenient (5-3-E9)[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] Prologue, Stage 1 and Stage 2 Achievements retroactively unlock despite having played the Demo version now
[*] Fixed a bug that caused performance to drop when switching between levels a lot during one session
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[*] Fixed a bug where fill blocks in D-Day could get you into an infinite death loop
[*] Fixed a bug where the germs that get cleaned after the tea cupboard cutscene would respawn after leaving and re-entering the room
[*] Fixed a bug where going through the door in 5-3 would freeze the game in the timed-challenge when entering one of the portals on the optional paths beforehand and the time ran out
[*] Fixed a bug where the active fuel would continue updating while using the "Retry Room" shortcut which could cause objects to trigger immediately after reloading the room
[*] Fixed a bug where a guest in Day of Disaster would stay activated and kill Greg whenever he used the double jump
[*] Fixed a bug where you would stay "sticky" even after dying
[*] Fixed a bug that would cancel your speedrun boost momentum after performing a wall jump

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
[*] Fixed lighting on pipe wheels
[*] Added missing pit particles in several rooms
[*] Fixed a missing middle ground section in 4-3
[*] Fixed timer wrapping in credits
[*] Fixed that rubbish trails would visibly disappear when dying
[*] Fixed that the stopwatch in timed-challenge would visibly disappear when quitting to Stage Selection
[*] Minor sort order fixes

[h2]Writing[/h2]
[*] Fixed a spelling error in Crossing a Bridge ("head-ache" -> "headache")
[*] Fixed a spelling error in Crossing a Bridge German ("Famulator" -> "Famulatur")

[h2]UI[/h2]
[*] Fixed a bug that leaving and re-entering the file while hard mode is selected made that stage's card unselected

[h2]Sound[/h2]
[*] Changed the voices in the intro of the 5-4 OST 
[*] Made the overdrive in 3-1 intro more apparent
[*] Adjusted volume in Days of Disaster

[h2]Other[/h2]
[*] Hard Mode achievements unlock properly now. If you have completed any of the Hard Modes before this patch, the achievements will unlock automatically upon loading the proper file.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could get a timed challenge in Crossing a Bridge when starting a new file after quitting out of a timed challenge from a different file
[*] Fixed a bug that notifications in 4-3 could be triggered multiple times
[*] Improved difficulty in second to last room in 5-3
[*] Credits are skippable now
[*] Fixed a bug that automatically set the resolution to 1920x1080 despite having set a different resolution manually
